subject: Request: short runway while PO routes — Mediora pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@mediora.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@mediora.com
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot next steps — PO delay update

Hi Camila & David,

Quick update from procurement here — our internal vendor onboarding has flagged the Redwood contract for additional security scoping. Contracts team expects an extra review cycle and they now estimate PO routing complete by May 10 (was May 4). The pilot environment is still running but we're hitting daily token limits for our evaluation.

Is there an option to keep the sandbox active for another week while we finish the review? Finance prefers not to sign anything until their checklist is cleared, but we still want to keep the momentum with the engineering team.

I attached the internal timeline the procurement team shared.

Attachment: PO-expected-timeline.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Mediora Health

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@mediora.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, contracts@mediora.com
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot next steps — PO delay update

Thanks for the heads up, Aisha — appreciate the transparency.

We can absolutely avoid the pilot expiring while procurement loops finish. Proposal:
- Freeze the pilot countdown for 7 days (May 4 — May 11) to match your timeline.
- Add a one-time trial credit of 5,000 generation tokens to cover ramp testing and a few larger integration runs.

Two asks on our side:
1) Please confirm the expected PO completion date (I see May 10 in the doc; if that slips we may need a follow-up).
2) If you can share a single-point contact at contracts (name & phone) we’ll document the extension and the trial credit in our internal approvals.

I’ve looped David for a quick manager approval on the credit. No invoice changes required for a temporary credit.

—Camila
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi team —

Thanks Camila for the suggested approach. I approve the 7-day countdown freeze and the 5,000 token trial credit as a one-time courtesy for Mediora to preserve momentum.

To be explicit: this is a temporary credit (no impact to invoicing or the PO), effective today, expires 2028-05-11 23:59 UTC. We will automatically restore normal token limits on May 12 unless we hear otherwise.

Camila, please add a brief note to the CRM record and ask Mediora to confirm the contracts point-of-contact so CS can track the PO movement.

Marissa — tagging you to confirm this is within our current pilot credit policy limits; if you want a longer duration we can escalate to commercial ops.

Regards,
David Kim
Senior Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0133
